Fixed in c94fc8fcd: after a key's value and subkey enumeration RegQueryInfoKeyW is re-run and the counts and last-write time compared with the first query; a mismatch marks the read Capped (partial, no removals) so the next tick re-reads. Windows-only reader: covered by compile plus the existing live cases (no fault seam, see cr2-K-F2); the Windows re-run at c94fc8fcd is pending.

trigger: a registry tick lands in a sibling plugin's temporary logged-out profile mount (HKU\YUZU_HIVE_<sid>_<16hex>_<n>)
classification_rationale: is_user_hive_name accepted any HKU name except .x and *_classes
summary: [governance r2] arm() would open persistent KEY_NOTIFY handles in a sibling plugin's mount, so that plugin's non-forced RegUnLoadKeyW fails and the user's NTUSER.DAT stays loaded and exclusively locked until agent restart; each mount also burns 5 of the 62 watch slots.
Fixed in c94fc8fcd: only SID-shaped names ('S-1-' then [0-9-]) are accepted; a pure unit test covers S-1-5-21-..., S-1-5-18, YUZU_HIVE_... (rejected), .DEFAULT and the _Classes spelling (rejected).

classification_rationale: 'slow tick (300 s)', 'hourly full re-read' and 'rows land at the slow tick' hold only at the default; the reconcile is kReconcileEveryTicks = 12 ticks
summary: [governance r2] Timing wording is true only at the default tick interval.
Fixed in c94fc8fcd: '12 slow ticks (hourly at the default 300 s)' in the manual, the implementer doc and tar.yaml; README/plugin docs regenerated.

trigger: a user holding WRITE_DAC on their own HKU key adds a deny ACE for the agent account
classification_rationale: a deny ACE written by the key's owner still blinds that key to the agent
summary: [governance r2] Root-level behaviour predates the child-skip delta; the delta extends it to children. The reporter labelled it MEDIUM; the recorder derives I1 with E3, which the table bands HIGH, and the row is recorded at the derived band. Fixing it needs REG_OPTION_BACKUP_RESTORE plus SeBackupPrivilege, a privilege-model change. I1 is present, so this finding MUST NOT be parked roadmap-#N or linked-to an unprioritised issue.

disposition: deferred-to-issue #TBD (to be filed after the PR is raised)
summary: DEFERRED (Architect ruling wf_88650413-9e4) to a follow-up issue after the PR exists; documented as a known limit in the PR body. A deferral over a derived-HIGH row, so the adjudication below applies.
adjudication_rationale: The residual is bounded by the gap row introduced by gov1-B4 for root-level and denied-set changes, predates the delta at root level, and the only complete fix is a privilege-model change that does not belong in a capture-source PR. independence is asserted, not enforced: the Architect is a subagent of the authoring session, the same actor under another name; separation applied is the de-escalation rule's non-author adjudicator, verifiable only as a non-self-naming string.

trigger: a user replaces a watched key with a link key to a same-hive target
classification_rationale: with OPEN_LINK TAR reads only the link's SymbolicLinkValue; additions under the target are invisible
summary: [governance r2] The trade-off of the gov1-B5 fix: a watched key that is itself a symbolic link is recorded as the link and its target is not followed. Reporter label MEDIUM; the recorder derives I1/E3 (HIGH) because a user can hide their own changes from the source. Following links would reintroduce gov1-B5.
Closed by DOCUMENTATION in c94fc8fcd (manual 'What is not recorded' and the implementer doc); no gap row added. This is an accepted residual, not a code fix, so it carries the adjudication below.
adjudication_rationale: Link-following is the gov1-B5 vulnerability; the alternative (a gap row) would fire on every legitimate symbolic-link key and was rejected as noise by the same ruling. independence is asserted, not enforced: the Architect is a subagent of the authoring session, the same actor under another name; separation applied is the de-escalation rule's non-author adjudicator, verifiable only as a non-self-naming string.

summary: [governance r2] Docs overstate the Unreadable carve-out. Reporter INFO; the recorder derives I7, MEDIUM.

classification_rationale: S1 (liveness signal), S2 (rollback step), HP-2 (unarmed counts Absent roots), D1 (denied set bound of 32) and C1/E-1 (opt-out leaves rows) are missing from the shipped docs
summary: [governance r2] Folded docs findings from governance r2: tar.md Health names registry_last_collect_ts staleness and the capture_incomplete heartbeat as the liveness signal; 'to roll back an agent run tar.purge_source registry first' in the implementer doc and the changelog fragment; registry_watch_roots_unarmed counts Absent roots and roots past the 62-handle cap (the dead-watcher signal is unarmed == roots); a denied child hides only itself up to kSkippedCap (32); registry_enabled=false leaves rows and baselines until tar.purge_source.
Fixed in c94fc8fcd (the five statements above in the manual, implementer doc, tar.yaml and the changelog fragment).

trigger: a user plants more than 32 access-denied children under one watched root
classification_rationale: behaviour or coverage gap noted by the reporter
summary: [governance r2] The 33rd denied child makes the read Capped for the whole walk, so later siblings are unread (G8-3 / UP-9). The Capped state is surfaced in status and never derives removals. Fix: count the overflow and keep walking. The recorder derives I6 (coverage of the later siblings is absent) rather than I1 because the state is visible and bounded to that root.
